title: Roles of one node
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 1 "Roles"), not implemented. The roles an admin gave one node, as an object {role name: that role's options}. A role is a permission and a duty at once: it opens the node's routes and is the only way work reaches it. A role that is absent is not held. A node ignores a role name it does not know, and an option it does not know. The hub assigns nothing by itself; a role whose needs the node's capabilities do not meet may still be set (it waits).

additionalProperties.description: A role this schema does not know yet: an object of options.

radio-receive.title: radio-receive
radio-receive.description: Needs a station token and at least one SDR. Many nodes may hold it.

channels.description: The node's channel set: each job it should run, with its coverage. Antenna groups stay on the node.

items.title: One job in the channel set
items.description: A conventional channel, paging, or a P25 system (one job per node).

coverage.description: `exclusive` runs on this node only; `overlap` on every listed node, copies deduplicated on the hub; `failover` on the first healthy node of a ranked list. A node that does not know the value does not run that job and reports it as not running.

feed-adapter.title: feed-adapter
feed-adapter.description: Needs a station token and the adapter installed and configured. Exactly one node is active at a time, by a lease (lease.schema.json).

priority.description: This node's place in the role's priority list, 1 first. One list for the whole cluster.

stt-light.title: stt-light
stt-light.description: Needs a station token and whisper up. A station's whisper as a pool worker, behind every gate it has today (own queue empty, a 90 s quiet spell, CPU under 85 %, the pool taking stations).

pool.description: The station's whisper is in the pool. Off on a new node.

classes.description: The pool classes it may take: never a pre-alert class.

items.description: A pool class that is not a pre-alert class (sizeup/sttpool.py). A class a reader does not know is left out, never an error.

max_s.description: The longest clip it is offered, seconds of audio. An upper bound only: the station's own measured pace can lower it, never raise it.

stt-heavy.title: stt-heavy
stt-heavy.description: Needs a worker token and whisper reported. A GPU worker's whisper.

classes.description: The pool classes it may take.

items.description: A pool class (sizeup/sttpool.py CLASSES). A class a reader does not know is left out, never an error.

fast.description: It may take the pre-alert classes. This can only narrow the hub's measured speed gate, never bypass it.

max_s.description: The longest clip it is offered, seconds of audio.

infer.title: infer
infer.description: Needs a worker token and a language model reported. Prompts go only to a node with a worker token and this role.

models.description: The models it may be asked for. Absent: any model the node serves.

adsb.title: adsb
adsb.description: Needs a station token and a dongle for it. The ADS-B receiver; every node with the role runs, and the hub merges by aircraft address.

dongle.description: The serial of the dongle reserved for it.

ais.title: ais
ais.description: Needs a station token and a dongle for it. The AIS receiver; every node with the role runs, and the hub merges by vessel id.

dongle.description: The serial of the dongle reserved for it.

training.title: training
training.description: Needs a worker token and a GPU. One node at a time. Named in the design, its options are not designed yet.
